question: Dawnglow Infusion gains me life if green mana or white mana was spent to cast it. Does a copy of Dawnglow Infusion gain me any life?

expected.shortAnswer: No: mana isn't an object, so a copy won't cause you to gain life, whatever mana was spent on the original.
expected.answer: Dawnglow Infusion is a sorcery that reads, “You gain X life if {G} was spent to cast this spell and X life if {W} was spent to cast it.” Because mana isn’t an object, a copy of Dawnglow Infusion won’t cause you to gain any life, no matter what mana was spent to cast the original spell.
